Author: Serpens66
Name: Extended Data
Description: Adds portable Custom and Coop Trail data plus complete Script Extender Custom Lord Workshop packages.

Changes: Retain active Map, Trail and Savegame mod settings, author rules, source attribution and locks across confirmed restarts; discard abandoned session state.
Use APIShared mission-settings, mod-data and load/save requester services while preserving Lord readiness checks and editor save choices.
Start packaged Coop missions with their custom AI castle and behaviour data without requiring BugfixesAndQoL.
Preserve packaged Lord requirements and sidecar data when re-saving or exporting Custom and Coop Trails; report missing or conflicting mission assets explicitly.
Allow supported current-setting recovery when a save contains an unreadable APIShared settings record.
Avoid disabled synchronization and settings-log preparation and cache repeated failure hashes.
Coop Trail packages exported with this version use mission schema 5 and need ExtendedData 1.0.16 or newer on every player's game.

Check packaged Coop starts with APIShared's Coop start preview: contradicting AI selections and unsynchronized castle lists block at the start button with a message instead of aborting the start; a host selection that differs only after the first castle uses the synchronized list.
Limit the Trail Maker embedded-map cache to the 16 most recently used maps and 256 MB; the map of the current Maker Load is always kept.
Require APIShared 0.12.5 or newer.
Use the APIShared load/save requester service while retaining Lord readiness checks and editor save options.
Bind mission origin to session ownership; preserve new launches and restored Coop provenance, and release abandoned client starts.
Retain current Map and Trail mod settings, source attribution and locks across confirmed mission restarts instead of reloading their original values.
Accept equivalent local and subscribed Workshop Lord packages when exporting Custom and Coop Trails; report source paths and conflicting data when packages differ.
version bump
Expose source package paths and Workshop subscription status for Coop Trail import rows, enabling safe local Trail deletion in Bugfixes and QoL.
Show a short Trail export failure dialog pointing to LogOutput.log; retain the affected mission and Lord-source details in the log.
Cache validated Fixes preference property metadata without caching values or changing snapshot validation.
Rate-limit repeated diagnostics and avoid unnecessary logging work; warnings and errors remain available, with suppressed-repeat counts on subsequent reports.
Migrate to APIShared 0.5.0 shared services and updated mod-owned adapters while preserving existing features.
Move routine diagnostics to Debug; preserve warnings, errors and explicit file-operation results.

Fix Coop Trail export and embedded Lord selection when an Extended Lord has an empty saved name; resolve its type and reuse the same author source for Lord and AIV files, matching AIV name and checksum together.
Exclude ExtendedData own options from saved gameplay mod-settings snapshots; compatible mods still retain their host settings.
Preserve restart safety when an optional settings provider is removed or unavailable.
Added grouped, filtered, and paged settings for the Fixes integration with deferred row creation.
Preserved typed Fixes preference values in Custom Lord and mod-setting snapshots.
Added per-mod trail setting selection and startup-setting preparation with restart checks.
Improved Custom Lord synchronization and trail/savegame settings coordination.
Compacts and validates Custom Lord data snapshots with size limits while accepting legacy payloads.
Adjusts the load/save requester layout for Custom Lord data.
Choose current mod settings when loading eligible saves while retaining Trail creator rules.
Ignores text files throughout Custom Lord folders and keeps media files out of multiplayer gameplay checks regardless of location.
Defaults new compatible Map and Trail settings to Fixed value and narrows the Mod Settings layout.
Preserves complete Custom Trail multiplayer settings, teams, colours, preferred AIVs, and embedded mod settings in exported Coop Trails.
Combined Custom Custom Trail and Custom Lord Upload into Extended Data.
Centralized Trail sidecars, complete Custom Lord packages, and direct Custom/Extended Lord JSON staging behind one Workshop upload coordinator.
Cancels uploads when requested extended files cannot be staged safely.
